relations.text: 合弁会社Caterpillar-Trimble Control Technologiesを通じ、土工機械向けの誘導・制御製品を開発している
relations.text_en: Trimble and Caterpillar run a joint venture, Caterpillar-Trimble Control Technologies, to develop guidance and control products for earth-moving machines

source.label: Trimble 10-K(2026年1月2日期)
source.quote: Our joint venture with Caterpillar, Caterpillar-Trimble Control Technologies, was formed to develop the next generation of advanced electronic guidance and control products for earth-moving machines.

relations.text: 合弁会社PTx Trimbleを通じ、農業向けの誘導・制御製品を開発している
relations.text_en: Trimble maintains the PTx Trimble joint venture with AGCO to develop guidance and control products for agriculture

source.label: Trimble 10-K(2026年1月2日期)
source.quote: We maintain a joint venture, PTx Trimble, with AGCO to develop the next generation of advanced electronic guidance and control products for agriculture.

relations.text: 建設業向けの計測ソリューションを共同開発する合弁会社を持つ
relations.text_en: Trimble maintains a joint venture with Hilti to jointly develop measuring solutions for the building construction trades

source.label: Trimble 10-K(2026年1月2日期)
source.quote: We also maintain a joint venture with Hilti, which focuses on the joint development of measuring solutions for the building construction trades and integrating data for construction management.

relations.text: 日本で測量機器を設計・製造する合弁会社を持つ
relations.text_en: Trimble's joint venture with Nikon designs and manufactures surveying instruments in Japan

source.label: Trimble 10-K(2026年1月2日期)
source.quote: Our joint venture with Nikon focuses on the design and manufacture in Japan of surveying instruments including mechanical total stations and related products.

relations.text: ハードウェア製品の製造を委託している主要な製造パートナーである
relations.text_en: Jabil is one of Trimble's key contract manufacturing partners for hardware products

source.label: Trimble 10-K(2026年1月2日期)
source.quote: We outsource the manufacturing of many of our hardware products to our key contract manufacturing partners, which include Jabil and Benchmark Electronics Inc.
